# Joule

> Joule is an inference power economics engine that ties physical GPU energy to token throughput and SLO goodput.

Founded by Abi Aryan. Site: https://joule.lat/

## Product

- Phase-aware inference power economics
- Prefill vs decode attribution
- $/M tokens, tokens/W, TTFT, TPOT beside SLOs
- joule-agent and joule-core run in the customer perimeter
